+def test_testclient_response_debug(test_client_factory: TestClientFactory) -> None:
+    template = object()
+    context = {"name": "World"}
+    debug_messages = [
+        {"traceback": ["frame 1", "frame 2"]},
+        {"template": template, "context": context, "extra": "debug value"},
+    ]
+
+    async def app(scope: Scope, receive: Receive, send: Send) -> None:
+        info = debug_messages.pop(0)
+        await send({"type": "http.response.debug", "info": info})
+        await Response("Hello, world!")(scope, receive, send)
+
+    client = test_client_factory(app)
+
+    response = client.get("/")
+    assert response.extensions["http.response.debug"] == {"traceback": ["frame 1", "frame 2"]}
+
+    response = client.get("/")
+    assert response.extensions["http.response.debug"] == {
+        "template": template,
+        "context": context,
+        "extra": "debug value",
+    }
+    assert response.template is template  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
+    assert response.context is context  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
+
